transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Well, honestly, I'm here because HR at my company and my sister both keep telling me I've gotten too thin. They've been pretty on me about it. But from my perspective, I just see that my suits fit a lot sharper now. My weight has just kept dropping since my divorce, and I don't really see the problem they're seeing.
Do you feel overweight even though other people say you’re too thin?

I wouldn't say I feel overweight overall, exactly. But... well, when I look in the mirror before a meeting or a date, I definitely zero right in on my stomach and my face. If I think I look soft in those areas, I just feel like people are going to see me as sloppy or weak. So I guess I just see things they aren't seeing.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yeah, I am. Honestly, if the scale is even a pound higher—like after a client dinner or a weekend out in Miami—I get this immediate panic. It just feels like I'm losing control. So right away, I start planning exactly how I'm going to cut back the next day to fix it.
Have you been deliberately eating less to keep from gaining weight?

Yeah, I definitely do. Most days, I just stick to coffee in the morning to get going. Then maybe I'll grab a protein bar between sales calls if I really need it. For dinner, I usually just have something small, like grilled chicken, but no rice or anything heavy. It's just... if I sit down and eat a full, regular meal, I feel like I completely messed up the whole day. So keeping it strict just works better for me.
What is your current weight and height?

I'm about 5'10". And right now, I weigh... I think around 125 pounds. 

Honestly, I'm really only here because HR at work and my sister keep saying I've gotten too thin. But... I don't know, from my side, I just see that my suits fit a lot sharper. My weight has just kept dropping since my divorce, sure, but I don't really see the problem they're seeing.
Do you believe your current weight is too low?

Not really, no. I mean, I know everyone else is making a big deal about my weight, but I don't see it. I still jog, I'm out there working my territory every day, and I'm hitting all my sales numbers. So... it just doesn't feel like some medical emergency to me. I feel fine.
Have you been trying to lose weight on purpose?

Yeah, I am. Or at least, I'm definitely trying to make sure I don't gain any of it back. It's just... if I step on the scale and it's even a pound higher, like after a big client dinner or a weekend out in Miami, I get this immediate panic. It just feels like I'm losing control. So the second I see that number go up, I start planning exactly how I'm going to cut back the next day to fix it.
Have you ever made yourself vomit after eating?
No, I've never done that. That's not really my thing. If I need to fix it, I just eat less or skip meals. I don't make myself throw up.
